messages.subject: Noise cut-off
parts:
First of all, I would like to thank you for developing such a great tool!

We want to remove noise-biased peptide abundances to enrich truth and reduce the multiple comparison burden. Currently, we are picking the cut-off value arbitrability in the absence of a trend in the noise-model.



What are the parameter settings that provide for abundance estimation but preserve real variability?  

What happens at the data process step that makes the coefficient of variation (CV) invariant regardless of abundance value?

Thank you,

Fahad
